label: ZS-042 RTC Module
description: This is the ZS-042 RTC module which uses the Maxim DS3231 real time clock IC. The module has a battery holder for a LIR2032 or CR2032. The module also includes an Atmel AT24C32 32K EEPROM for storing important information. The module can operate at 3V3 and 5V.
